light_description: Historical MSS14 military-series distortion, developed as the next mainline distortion after the MSS06 family; official builder shop documents it as a distinct model.
Compact high-end fuzz using an AC127 germanium transistor and front-mounted jacks; designed for guitar or bass.
Wide-gain distortion using an LM386 audio amplifier, with a switchable mid emphasis/cut range documented by ECB/NAMM.
Original MSS06 guitar/bass overdrive generation; TS-based, with expanded frequency and distortion range and selectable guitar/bass operation.
MSS06 RS generation with added RS booster and Straight/Addictive modes; retained as a documented generation of the MSS06 family rather than a new conceptual model.
Updated MSS06 C generation produced under the builder's integrated-board production plan; retains the MSS06 concept while expanding the pre-gain range.
Frost signature edition derived from the MSS14 family; preserved as a signature/special relationship record rather than a new base model.
